title: fix(money): explain full-refund pause and explicit coach restart (T4)
body:
## MONEY-REFUND-124 — agent 124

T4: customer-facing billing/access truth and coach consent to resume billing. Opening fix round; independent dual audit required.

### Changes
- Preserve the backend's `refund_paused` / `refund` state rather than treating a full refund as an unpaid card or bank dispute.
- Client lockout, banner and card screen explain the full refund and owning-coach restart; no card-charge-to-restore promise.
- Coach client detail lists refund-paused plans and offers the existing Restart plan route.
- Confirmation makes renewed billing explicit and states the refund is not reversed.
- Ordinary disputes retain their original explanation and confirmation.

### Regression proof
`src/__tests__/moneyRefund124.test.tsx`: normalized contract, client truth, unconfirmed billing pause, coach roster and restart confirmation. This PR's own CI is the candidate proof; no mobile extra lane.

### Compatibility and defaults
Works with the existing backend: ordinary payment/dispute states are unchanged; new refund states are optional. Backend companion supplies refund billing pause and existing coach restart. No new billing action or endpoint. B=0 separately; companion backend B3 is completed by this mobile slice. U=1 refund-specific client/coach copy. C=0; frozen edge cases not investigated.

No merge, deployment, production flag changes or paid builds.
